text:
incidentbot: PagerDuty alert fired: [INC-2026] High HTTP 5xx rate on inference-gateway-usw2. Trigger: error_rate(5xx) > 5% over 3m. Link: https://pd.example/INC-2026
pagerduty: PagerDuty: incident INC-2026 created and routed to on-call (alex).
alex: acked. I'm the oncall, looking now.
sam: saw the spike ~09:12 - upstreams returning 502/504, connection resets in proxy logs. sample: `upstream sentinel: connection reset by peer`
kevin: checking metrics — 5xx % = 8.1 for last 4m, traffic concentrated on POST /v1/generate, p95 latency unchanged. region: usw2 primary.
andrea: any customer-facing errors reported?
kevin: Support ticket stream shows a handful of errors from two enterprise customers in US-West, approx 12 failed requests/min each. Not widespread yet.
alex: repro-ing with curl against gateway internal LB — seeing 502s with `KVCacheEvict` errors in the gateway logs.
sam: logs: `kvcache: eviction failed: shard-io-timeout` and `http: upstream returned 502 (model-host-3)` — looks like model hosts hitting IO spikes.
alex: scaling gateway deployment from 4 -> 10 to absorb burst. `kubectl scale deploy inference-gateway --replicas=10`
andrea: good. Can we route traffic off usw2 while model hosts recover?
kevin: starting a traffic slice shift: divert 25% of traffic to eu-west1 and 15% to apac for low-latency tolerant routes. updating route weights now.
sam: also bumping HPA target CPU to 70% for the gateway pods to allow autoscaler to add nodes faster.
alex: initiated warmup calls to model pool and took one suspected model-host (model-host-3) out of rotation.
andrea: opening a customer incident channel for the affected enterprise accounts; support on it.
kevin: as a precaution, switching tiered fallback: point low-priority requests to quantized-cpu variant to reduce load on model-hosts.
sam: observed backend disk IO queue depth spike on model-host-3 cluster, ops paged infra team to dig in.
alex: setting incident status to investigating. Will update with timeline & mitigation in 15m.
andrea: if this looks like broader capacity exhaustion we'll consider temporary rate-limiting for anonymous/free tier to protect paid customers.
pagerduty: Acknowledgement recorded: alex at 1811122340. Incident linked: INC-2026.
kevin: current 5xx down to 3.2% after scaling & reroute, still watching.
andrea: noted — please call out any rollback or config changes so we can track postmortem.
alex: logging mitigation steps in the incident doc. will follow up with RCA once stabilized. :white_check_mark:
